question: The National Multidimensional Poverty Index is released by the _________.

options.text: Ministry of Social justice and Empowerment

solution:
The correct answer is __**NITI Aayog.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The National Multidimensional Poverty Index **is released by the **NITI Aayog.**

 Multidimensional Poverty Index:- 

 
• It was first developed in 2010 by Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative and United Nations Development Programme.
 
• It uses three dimensions and ten indicators which are-
 
 
• Education- Years of schooling and child enrollment
 
• Health - Child Morality and Nutrition Standards
 
• Standard of Living - Electricity, flooring, drinking water, sanitation, cooking fuel and assets.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• NITI Aayog is not a constitutional body.
 
• It was established on January 1, 2015.
 
• It is formed in place of the Planning Commission.
 
• The ex-officio president of this is the Prime Minister.
 
• **NITI Aayog is the premier policy ‘Think Tank’ of the** Government of India, providing both directional and policy inputs.
